description: This header file declares functions for selecting a single group or instance within a set of instances, based on user input or matching selector options. It is part of the 'selector' namespace in the 'cuttlefish' project and defines interface functions for selecting groups and instances from an instance manager.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Selects a single group based on the request's selector options, prompting the user if multiple groups match and standard input is a terminal.

methods.name: SelectInstance
methods.description: Selects a single instance based on the request's selector options without prompting; fails if multiple matches are found and returns the group the selected instance belongs to.

calls: Result<std::pair<LocalInstance, LocalInstanceGroup>> SelectInstance(const InstanceManager&, const CommandRequest&)
